retained.interpretation: Ordinary hash 20.23%, equality 4.32%, serialization 5.29% lower median elapsed time. Parse 0.31% increase is within sample noise; no parse speedup claimed. Retained AST node memory unchanged. Shared graph hash 35.48%, equality 6.31% lower median elapsed time.

rejected.candidate: Early scalar/type dispatch in equality; reverted because shared graph equality was 7.03% slower and ordinary equality offered no measurable gain.

other_rejected_options.walk_to_pack: Cardinality derived by walking wrapper chains costs quadratic construction work in nesting depth and can expand shared member-pointer graphs.
other_rejected_options.weak_identity_map: Needs additional weak-reference storage and mapping/lifetime bookkeeping, and avoids neither metadata overhead nor complexity.
other_rejected_options.pack_only_node_subclasses: Changes exact public node classes and structural equality policy.
other_rejected_options.per_cardinality_int_subclasses: One dynamic class per cardinality adds substantial class allocation/cache/lifetime complexity.

additional_correctness.deep_stack: A 2,000-pointer tree under interpreter recursion limit50 previously raised RecursionError before the fixed guard. Internal stack exhaustion now uses the existing iterative fallback.
additional_correctness.custom_policy: Foreign operational RecursionError propagates without a second hash invocation; traceback-code ownership distinguishes it from internal stack exhaustion.
